posts.title: Ready for finishing
posts.description: Do I have red velvet? I believe I do but it may be really red and need toned down. Not today. Still working outside and will start on Christmas decorating. My hand is better since the antibiotics were stopped. Just a coincidence. Time is going by more quickly it seems. Until January when the months will drag until spring. Be well! **********

posts.title: Soon
posts.description: I hung my big berry and am loving it. Right now it's hanging with the ponies, not sure what I'll pull out for Christmas so keeping knobs bare for Santas. This is on an over the door candle hook. Hand was good last night, got quite a bit stitched. Not much more for a finish. While the heart monitor is on I plan to work outside this afternoon. posts.title: Ground stop
posts.description: All stitches in progress will continue to complete the current motif, new stitches will be halted until problem is resolved. I'm off one. But although the circulation to finger is better, thumb to middle is now numb on both hands. Carpal tunnel is acting up, maybe because of the blood vessel issue from Raynauds.
